title: DogTag dog-profile credential v1
description: recordType == DOG_PROFILE. Mirrors the DOG_PROFILE branch of packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/schema.ts's validateSchema. Every constraint here is fully expressible in JSON Schema; this record type declares no x-validationRules.

ownerIdentity.description: Owner's official identity. Keys must be present; empty strings are allowed for non-admin mint paths (schema.ts only checks isString, not non-empty).

weightHistory.description: Optional. When present, each entry is fully shape-checked (schema.ts validates every entry unconditionally once the array exists).

value.description: Canonical Decimal-shaped string. Magnitude has no constraint at this record type; unlike titer, schema.ts places no minimum on a weight value.

microchip.description: Optional for DOG_PROFILE (needsChip is false here unless the credential's top-level cdcPath == "standard", a cross-cutting rule this registry structurally enforces only in dogtag.cdc-import-form.v1 - see that schema's notes and specs/schemas/README.md). If present, still fully shape-validated.
